name: GPU-based Eraser and Digger Tools
definition: Interactive tools running on the GPU that remove voxels based on a 'painting' paradigm. They select voxels inside an imaginary volume (cone for perspective, cylinder for parallel projection) along a line-of-sight controlled by a 2D point on the screen (SRP).
summary: GPU-based Eraser and Digger Tools enable intuitive, real-time voxel removal via a painting paradigm, distinguishing themselves from static convex clipping by defining dynamic, user-controlled removal zones.
